"""Constant table for flapsim. All values are centi-units (integers)."""

FIELD_H = 1200     # playfield height
BIRD_X = 300       # bird's fixed horizontal position
BIRD_W = 80        # bird width
BIRD_H = 80        # bird height

G = 18             # gravity added to vy each tick
FLAP_V = -27       # vy is SET to this on a flap (not added)
VY_MAX = 260       # terminal downward speed

SCROLL = 40        # how far pipes move left per tick
PIPE_W = 120       # pipe width
GAP_H = 1000       # vertical gap height
SPAWN_X = 2000     # x at which a new pipe appears
SPAWN_EVERY = 45   # spawn when t % SPAWN_EVERY == 0
GLIDE_VY = 40      # |vy| at or below this counts as a clean glide

"""Per-tick bird physics: flap/gravity, integration, ceiling and floor."""

from units import G, FLAP_V, VY_MAX, FIELD_H, BIRD_H


def step_bird(y, vy, flap):
    """Advance the bird one tick. Returns (y, vy, alive).

    A flap SETS vy to FLAP_V (never clamped). Gravity is added otherwise and
    clamped at VY_MAX. The ceiling is soft (clamps y, zeroes vy); the floor
    kills the bird.
    """
    if flap:
        vy = FLAP_V
    else:
        vy = min(vy + G, VY_MAX)
    y += vy
    alive = True
    if y < 0:
        y = 0
        vy = 0
    elif y + BIRD_H > FIELD_H:
        y = FIELD_H - BIRD_H
        alive = False
    return y, vy, alive

"""Axis-aligned collision with half-open intervals. Edges do not collide."""

from units import BIRD_X, BIRD_W, BIRD_H, GAP_H


def rect_overlap(a0, a1, b0, b1):
    """True iff the half-open intervals [a0,a1) and [b0,b1) overlap."""
    return a0 < b1 and b0 < a1


def pipe_hit(y, pipe):
    """True if the bird at height y hits the given pipe.

    The bird occupies [BIRD_X, BIRD_X+BIRD_W) x [y, y+BIRD_H). A hit requires
    horizontal overlap AND being outside the open gap
    [gap_top, gap_top + GAP_H).
    """
    x = pipe["x"]
    gap_top = pipe["gap_top"]
    horizontal = rect_overlap(BIRD_X, BIRD_X + BIRD_W, x, x + PIPE_W)
    outside = y < gap_top or y + BIRD_H > gap_top + GAP_H
    return horizontal and outside
